title: KineState-SWAM: A Surgical World Action Model with Explicit Kinematics and Causal Interaction Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.28871v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing surgical world models often leave implicit how instrument motion drives localized tissue responses and how interaction history informs subsequent actions. We introduce KineState-SWAM, a surgical world-action model coupling action prediction and video generation through a persistent interaction state, separating kinematically determined instrument motion from learned scene evolution. A flow-matching policy predicts joint trajectories conditioned on interaction state, robot configuration, and task instruction. Kinematic Geometry Conditioning converts these trajectories into surface-motion tokens and spatially aligned instrument renderings using calibrated URDF kinematics. Causal Interaction Dynamics recurrently updates the state through geometry-guided attention and motion-aligned feature transport, carrying interaction history into subsequent action predictions without intermediate video synthesis. translated_title: KineState-SWAM：具有显式运动学与因果交互动力学的手术世界动作模型
translated_abstract: 现有的手术世界模型通常将器械运动如何驱动局部组织响应、以及交互历史如何影响后续动作这些机制作隐式处理。我们提出KineState-SWAM，这是一种手术世界-动作模型，通过一个持久的交互状态将动作预测与视频生成耦合起来，将运动学确定的器械运动与学习到的场景演化分离开来。流匹配策略在交互状态、机器人构型和任务指令的条件下预测关节轨迹。运动学几何条件化（Kinematic Geometry Conditioning）利用标定的URDF运动学，将这些轨迹转换为表面运动token和空间对齐的器械渲染。因果交互动力学（Causal Interaction Dynamics）通过几何引导的注意力和运动对齐的特征传输递归地更新状态，将交互历史带入后续的动作预测中，而无需中间视频合成。状态-几何适配器（State-Geometry Adapter）……
tldr: 提出KineState-SWAM手术世界动作模型，通过持久交互状态耦合动作预测与视频生成，利用显式运动学几何条件化和因果交互动力学，将运动学确定的器械运动与学习到的场景演化分离建模，无需中间视频合成即可将交互历史传递到后续动作预测。
en_tdlr: KineState-SWAM is a surgical world-action model that couples action prediction and video generation through a persistent interaction state, employing explicit kinematic geometry conditioning and causal interaction dynamics to separate kinematically determined instrument motion from learned scene evolution while carrying interaction history into subsequent action predictions without intermediate video synthesis.
